content.text:
Synced groups can now share a display name, and repeat syncs update the same groups in place without creating new ones.

**What changed**

- **`server/models/Group.ts`**: the team-wide name check now depends on whether a group has an `externalId`:
  - Groups with an `externalId` only conflict with groups in the team that have the same `externalId` and the same name (case-insensitive).
  - Hand-made groups (no `externalId`) only conflict with other hand-made groups, case-insensitively.
  - A hand-made group and a synced group can therefore have the same name. Without this, updating a hand-made "Engineering" after a synced "Engineering" appeared would fail the same way syncs fail today.
  - I also changed the `externalId` field's type to `string | null`, which matches the database.
- **`server/commands/groupsSyncer.ts`**:
  - Groups created by the sync now store the provider's group id as `externalId`. Until now the sync never set it, which is why every synced group fell under the team-wide check.
  - Groups created by older syncs have no `externalId`. The next sync fills it in, in the same update that syncs the name and description. That should clear up teams already stuck on `The name of this group is already in use`, including ones with same-named duplicates already in the database. If a group already has an `externalId`, the sync leaves it alone.

**Tests**

- **`server/models/Group.test.ts`** checks that:
  - hand-made duplicates are rejected regardless of case;
  - the same name in different teams is allowed;
  - different `externalId`s with the same name are allowed, including when an existing group is saved again;
  - a hand-made and a synced group can share a name;
  - the same `externalId` with the same name is rejected.
- **`server/commands/groupsSyncer.test.ts`** checks that:
  - two provider groups called "Engineering" are created, and a second sync creates nothing and updates the same rows;
  - a synced group can share a name with an existing hand-made group;
  - older synced groups with no `externalId` get it filled in and are renamed without errors.

All 78 tests pass across those two files, `server/routes/api/groups/groups.test.ts` and the presenter tests. With the source changes removed, 5 of the 8 new tests fail, so they catch the original bug. `yarn tsc`, oxlint and oxfmt are clean on the changed files.

**Things to know**

- The name check still runs its query outside the sync's database transaction, so it can't see rows created earlier in the same transaction. That doesn't matter for different `externalId`s. But two groups with the *same* `externalId` and name created in one transaction would get past it. The sync can't produce that case, because it looks groups up by external id first.
- A group with `externalId` set to an empty string isn't treated as hand-made: it's only checked against other empty-string groups, not against groups with no `externalId`.

Nothing is committed.
